newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 18.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on June 18. Reuters has not verified these stories and does notvouch for their accuracy.

Bank Indonesia governor Soedradjad Djiwandono said the central bank will continue to watch closely the value of the rupiah to balance the needs of exporters who want a weaker rupiah with the competing need to continue to attract foreign funds into Indonesia's capital markets.

The General Election Committee has given the three parties eight more days to decide whether they will trade votes to increase the number of seats in the House of Representatives won by the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI).

Lawyers from the state-owned plane maker Industri Pesawat Terbang Nusantara (IPTN) and The Jakarta Post daily have agreed to settle out of court a dispute over damages after the paper published an erroneous report about a crash of one of the company's test aircraft.
